title: On Cutting the rope with one stroke
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：cut　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cut 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the gardener ① cut the rope with one stroke before dawn, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② cuts the rope with one stroke in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cut the rope with one stroke at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cut the rope with one stroke before — a line in the notebook for April 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Cutting the rope with one stroke before dawn, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cut the cost to half the old sum in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cut the cost to half the old sum at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ cuts the cost to half the old sum before dawn every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cut the rope with one stroke again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cut the rope with one stroke, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody cuts the rope with one stroke in public again and somebody must cut the rope with one stroke before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 割断（一般过去式 cut the rope with one stroke：1976 年园丁头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 割断（一般现在 cuts the rope with one stroke：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 割断（不定式 to cut the rope with one stroke：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 割断（过去完成时 had cut the rope with one stroke：1970 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 割断（动名词 cutting the rope with one stroke 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 削减（cut the cost to half the old sum：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去削减把花费减到从前的一半）
G. v. 削减（cut the cost to half the old sum：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 割断（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 cuts the cost to half the old sum，而母亲又一次 cut the rope with one stroke）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cut 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the gardener cut the rope with one stroke before dawn, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener cuts the rope with one stroke in public whenever the garden asks.
Cutting the rope with one stroke before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cut the cost to half the old sum in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden cuts the cost to half the old sum before dawn every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cut the rope with one stroke again, and the garden remembered that half.
